benefits.title: More clarity for deciding what comes next.
benefits.lede: Vitality brings together what helps you follow your eating routine without turning it into a complicated task.
benefits.planBody: Organize meals around your goals and preferences.
benefits.macrosBody: See your daily summary and follow each meal's composition.
benefits.diaryBody: Log what you ate when it happens, with more context.
benefits.swapsBody: Adjust foods and meals without losing your plan's organization.

showcase.title: Not a prototype. It's the screen waiting for you on first login.
showcase.lede: No dressed-up version just to sell. What you see below is exactly the Dashboard that opens the moment you sign in.
showcase.callout1Body: Counts up for real to the final value, it doesn't just appear ready.
showcase.callout2Body: Time in the center of a second ring, with the foods shown as chips.
showcase.callout3Body: Level and XP move forward from real diary use, no extra action needed.

problem.title: Calculating your calorie goal on your own is spreadsheets, formulas and guesswork.
problem.body: Most nutrition apps expect you to already know your goal, or hand you a generic number without explaining where it came from. Vitality PLUS does the math for you and shows every step to the result, nothing hidden.

howItWorks.title: A routine that fits into three steps.
howItWorks.lede: You don't need to know nutrition terms to take the first step.
howItWorks.step1Body: Tell us about your preferences and what your routine looks like.
howItWorks.step2Body: Keep daily meals together in one place when planning your day.
howItWorks.step3Body: Log meals and follow calories and macros through the day.
howItWorks.step4Title: Let AI build your meal plan
howItWorks.step4Body: A short quiz and Gemini generates the plan from scratch, within your goal.

features.label: Vitality features
features.title: Follow what matters in each moment.
features.lede: The screens show your plan, your logs, and your daily summary with enough context to keep moving forward.
features.detail: Made to follow your routine, not complicate it.
features.planBody: See your daily meals organized and understand how they fit into your plan.
features.planAlt: Vitality meal plan with organized meals
features.diaryBody: Log a meal and keep the day visible while you continue.
features.diaryAlt: Vitality food diary with a meal entry
features.macrosBody: Follow calories, protein, carbs, and fats directly.
features.macrosAlt: Vitality dashboard with daily calories and macros summary
features.swapsBody: Adjust meals when your routine changes, while keeping the plan as a reference.
features.swapsAlt: Vitality meal plan with food swap option

guidance.title: Information to support your choices.
guidance.body: Vitality offers general food suggestions and does not replace guidance from a nutrition professional, especially for clinical conditions.

aiDiet.title: From your answers to a finished plate, no fuss.
aiDiet.lede: A short quiz (how many meals a day, what to avoid) and Gemini builds the menu from scratch, within your goal. No fixed list and no shuffling between ready-made foods.

aiDiet.quoteCite: written by the AI itself from your goal, not a fixed example text

trust.title: No black box. You see exactly where every calculation comes from.
trust.body: There's no user or review to show here yet because the product is new. What we can show is the method, open, and the product actually working in the screenshots above.
trust.item1Body: Basal Metabolic Rate by Mifflin-St Jeor, multiplied by your activity factor.
trust.item2Body: TACO table (Brazilian base) plus USDA Foundation Foods: not a made-up list.
trust.item3Body: No credit card at signup, no trial period that turns into a charge on its own.

faq.title: What you need to know to get started.
faq.q1: Do I need to understand nutrition to use it?
faq.a1: No. Vitality helps you organize routine information in a clearer, more gradual way.
faq.q2: What can I follow in the app?
faq.a2: You can organize a plan, log meals, and follow calories and macros throughout the day.
faq.q3: Does Vitality replace a nutrition professional?
faq.a3: No. It offers general suggestions for your routine and does not replace professional care, especially for clinical conditions.
faq.q4: Does it work in English too?
faq.a4: Yes: Portuguese and English, switched in real time from the top bar, without reloading the page.
faq.q5: Where does the food nutrition data come from?
faq.a5: TACO table (Brazilian reference) as the base, complemented by USDA Foundation Foods: over 600 items, per 100g.
